scope: Original pinned DID v0.7.0, IR20/ABI50. Test-only constructor-driven native and direct pure acceptance.
limits: Native state progression is not proven ledger history or deployment/network acceptance.
Only deactivate has Rust recording and the previous strict proof uses explicitly seeded prior state.
Captured TS public programs are replayed independently; native Rust does not expose its complete query stream.
Native errors consume their execution context; committed snapshot rollback and witness/error order are compared, not native internal partial state.
External witness call records are not rolled back by ContractLab.
Constructor kernel.self is the dummy address; these tests do not resolve real deployed DID identity.
Finite curve/hash cases are not exhaustive cryptographic-domain or collision-resistance proofs.

amendment_0259.scope: Original rotateControllerKey and recoverControllerKey recording added; native and pure semantic captures unchanged. amendment_0259.historical_baseline: The original ADR0255 scope, limits and stateful_export_summary remain the historical native acceptance baseline.

amendment_0265.scope: Original setAlsoKnownAs recording added; native and pure semantic captures unchanged. Two default-strict proofs follow actual original-data deployment and apply Unicode insert then remove; original constructor identity semantics unchanged.
amendment_0265.historical_baseline: Prior scope, limits, stateful_export_summary and ADR0259 amendment retain their historical scope.

amendment_0269.scope: Original setService and removeService recording added for nonempty flat named OpaqueString product Map values; native and pure semantic rows unchanged. Three default-strict proofs follow actual original-data deployment, applying Insert, Update and Remove. Constructor execution itself remains unproved; original stored zero id stays distinct from deployed address.
amendment_0269.historical_baseline: ADR0255 stateful_export_summary and prior ADR0259/0265 amendments are retained as historical snapshots; their earlier recorded availability is not current.
limits: The finite Service sequence and typed Map reducers do not admit nested, mixed or empty product Map values.
These sampled proof calls do not prove original constructor execution or all DID branches.

limits: Constructor execution itself is not proved; actual deployment uses unchanged original constructor data.
